title: Trump and Zelensky Meet at NATO Ankara Summit; NATO Pledges €70B Annual Aid for Ukraine
detail: July 8, 2026 — On the sidelines of the July 7-8 NATO summit in Ankara, Trump and Zelensky met for roughly an hour. Trump agreed to license Ukraine to produce Patriot interceptors domestically and said 'I think we've made a lot of progress' toward peace, though no ceasefire terms were announced. NATO separately pledged €70 billion per year in military aid for 2026-27, which Russia characterized as undercutting the diplomatic track even as Trump voiced optimism about a deal.

title: UN Commission of Inquiry Concludes Syria Visit, Notes Progress on Transitional Justice Law
detail: July 8, 2026 — UN Commission of Inquiry commissioners Monia Ammar and Fionnuala Ní Aoláin concluded a visit to Syria, noting progress on a transitional justice law and the start of trials addressing Assad-era violations, along with the designation of dedicated transitional-justice court chambers. The commissioners pressed the Syrian government for full accountability over the March 2025 coastal violence and July 2025 Suwayda violence, both still unresolved test cases for the post-Assad transition's credibility.
